canDoYue: 你識比較預繳同無限計劃，仲識開通電話卡。
canDoEn: Compare a prepaid plan with an unlimited plan, then activate a SIM.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Hello. Which phone plan is better for a short city trip?
dialogue.glossYue: 你好。邊個電話計劃適合市區短途？
dialogue.say: Hello. Which phone plan is better for a short city trip?

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: The prepaid plan is much cheaper, and the coverage is enough.
dialogue.glossYue: 預繳計劃平好多，覆蓋都夠。
dialogue.say: The prepaid plan is much cheaper, and the coverage is enough.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I'll take the prepaid one, and I do not need unlimited data.
dialogue.glossYue: 我要預繳嗰個，唔使無限數據。
dialogue.say: I'll take the prepaid one, and I do not need unlimited data.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: Please activate the new SIM card with your valid passport.
dialogue.glossYue: 請用你本有效護照開通呢張新電話卡。
dialogue.say: Please activate the new SIM card with your valid passport.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Is the unlimited plan locked on a long mobile contract?
dialogue.glossYue: 無限計劃係咪綁一份長手機合約？
dialogue.say: Is the unlimited plan locked on a long mobile [[ˈkɑntɹækt]]?

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: A small top-up is enough if that plan stays cheap.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果嗰個計劃平，小小增值就夠。
dialogue.say: A small top-up is enough if that plan stays cheap.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: I will pay for this prepaid SIM card here.
dialogue.glossYue: 我喺呢度畀錢買呢張預繳電話卡。
dialogue.say: I will pay for this prepaid SIM card here.

dialogue.speaker: mina
dialogue.text: The coverage on this SIM is enough for the city.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張卡嘅覆蓋夠市區用。
dialogue.say: The coverage on this SIM is enough for the city.
